policies.text: A device gains top promotional feature positioning when it achieves listing safety clearance and records an annual regional distribution volume of at least 10,000 units.
An accessory gains aquatic trade approval provided it holds a certified IP67 ingress rating.
A commercial appliance achieves energy efficiency endorsement when it demonstrates a thermal coefficient of at least 85% and maintains an operating voltage under 240 volts.
A food container obtains commercial packaging certification if it holds an active FDA compliance seal.

An item achieves listing safety clearance either by securing a laboratory rating of at least 90 points together with an annual failure percentage of no more than 2.0%, or by maintaining valid ISO 13485 credentials.
